title: Wilder Wildlife - Customize Enemy Spawns
author: oOCamilleOo

file.name: Wilder Wildlife
file.description: Choose wildlife sizing or replacement chance separately for boars and wolves. Use one shared enemy pool with conditional 1–10 group-size sliders. Enemy choices and counts persist through save loading until natural respawn.

summary: Adjust the size of ordinary boar herds and wolf packs, or replace them with enemies. Choose a shared enemy pool and individual 1–10 group-size ranges, with separate replacement chances for boars and wolves.
